vectors.name: names-sort-by-utf-16-code-units
vectors.description: Member names sort by their UTF-16 code units as unsigned integers (RFC 8785 §3.2.3): the emoji U+1F600, stored as the surrogates D83D DE00, sorts before U+FB33, though its code point is greater.

vectors.name: numbers-use-the-ecmascript-form-and-minus-zero-is-zero
vectors.description: Numbers are serialised as ECMAScript's Number-to-String does (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3): shortest round-trip digits, exponents from 1e21 up and below 1e-6, a lower-case e with an explicit sign, and -0 as 0.

vectors.name: strings-escape-only-what-json-must
vectors.description: Strings escape the quote, the backslash and the control characters below U+0020 (backspace, tab, line feed, form feed and carriage return by their short escapes, the others as lower-case six-character escapes); the solidus, DEL and every other character are written as themselves (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2).

vectors.name: nested-values-have-no-whitespace-and-sorted-members-at-every-level
vectors.description: Arrays keep their order; objects are sorted at every depth; literals are true, false and null.
